papers.title: Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR
papers.summary: EDEN improves reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by injecting anchored embedding noise into rollout conditioning to increase diversity and strengthen group-relative advantage signals without altering inference.

papers.title: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
papers.summary: Selection bias and order sensitivity in multiple-choice models are decomposed into flip rate and positional skew via pooled standard deviation, showing that prior correction and aggregation target different factors and should be reported together with accuracy.

papers.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
papers.summary: Gen4P repurposes a pretrained video generator into a feed-forward 4D perceiver that predicts geometry and motion from monocular video via on-demand cross-attention decoding and frozen depth priors.

papers.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
papers.summary: Remote KV caching for long-context LLM serving can severely degrade latency unless the store is sharded by parallel rank, loaded asynchronously, and paired with high-bandwidth retrieval, yielding large throughput gains.

papers.title: Virtual Head Attention
papers.summary: Virtual Head Attention improves long-context model efficiency by reducing KV cache and compute while preserving quality through lightweight linear query and output transformations.
